english.title: Public service vehicle - passenger use travel mandate issued for another person

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: PUBLIC SERVICE VEHICLES CONDUCT OF DRIVERS

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a passenger on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), used for the carriage of passengers at separate fares, used a travel mandate which had been issued for use by another person on terms that it was not transferable.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(1)(b) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25 of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

which had been issued to another

(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
